title: Could eating jellyfish be sustainable
paragraphs: While giant sharks are more common sea monsters in films, jellyfish also pose a major threat in real life – with some able to kill people with their stings. And the potential danger they cause doesn’t stop there, with reports of them attacking salmon farms, shutting down power stations and incapacitating warships. There are even some scientists in Australia researching whether box jellyfish could ultimately destroy our oceans – so could devouring them be a possible solution?

The huge number of jellyfish in our oceans means that if we did start eating them, there is already a large supply of these potential morsels to be dined on. Also, some people argue that due to their reproductive cycle, jellyfish are actually a sustainable food source. Removing a jellyfish from the ocean doesn’t stop new ones being born. This is because they are spawned from polyps on the seabed. In some ways, you can compare them to apples. When you take an apple from a tree, the tree still goes on to produce more apples.

What about their nutritional value? Jellyfish contain 36 calories per ounce, which puts it on a par with iceberg lettuce. However, unlike lettuce, it is full of protein, making it potentially a great diet food. And indeed, in many parts of the world, particularly in Asia, they are already consumed, often raw, fried or chopped up as part of a salad. The demand for these animals, combined with their numbers, means that selling jellyfish is becoming an ever more lucrative business.

But what do they taste like? While some say they are flavourless, others describe them as having a salty taste. This could be due to their absorbent nature, which also leads them to being often served in a sauce. As for the texture, some people negatively compare the experience to eating gristle.

So, the next time you fancy chowing down on some fish, you might look at jellyfish as a sustainable alternative. They might not be the tastiest thing you’ve ever eaten, but it beats fleeing the sea to avoid being stung.

vocabulary.entry: sting /stɪŋ/ n. 刺蜇；毒刺
vocabulary.example: The sting of a box jellyfish can be fatal to humans.
vocabulary.translation: 箱型水母的刺蜇对人类可能是致命的。

vocabulary.entry: salmon farm /ˈsæmən fɑːm/ n. 三文鱼养殖场
vocabulary.example: The salmon farm was forced to close after a jellyfish attack.
vocabulary.translation: 这家三文鱼养殖场在遭遇水母袭击后被迫关闭。

vocabulary.entry: power station /ˈpaʊə ˈsteɪʃn/ n. 发电站
vocabulary.example: The coastal power station was shut down by a massive jellyfish swarm.
vocabulary.translation: 这座沿海发电站因遭遇大规模水母群而停运。

vocabulary.entry: incapacitate /ˌɪnkəˈpæsɪteɪt/ v. 使丧失能力；使无行动能力
vocabulary.example: The ship's engines were incapacitated by the jellyfish blocking the intake.
vocabulary.translation: 水母堵塞了进水口，导致船只引擎无法运转。

vocabulary.entry: warship /ˈwɔːʃɪp/ n. 军舰
vocabulary.example: The navy reported a warship being incapacitated by jellyfish in the strait.
vocabulary.translation: 海军通报称，一艘军舰在海峡因水母侵袭而失去行动能力。

vocabulary.entry: box jellyfish /ˈbɒks ˈdʒelifɪʃ/ n. 箱型水母
vocabulary.example: Box jellyfish are among the most venomous marine creatures.
vocabulary.translation: 箱型水母是毒性最强的海洋生物之一。

vocabulary.entry: devour /dɪˈvaʊə/ v. 狼吞虎咽地吃；吞噬
vocabulary.example: The hungry children devoured the cakes in a matter of minutes.
vocabulary.translation: 饥饿的孩子们几分钟就把蛋糕狼吞虎咽地吃光了。

vocabulary.entry: morsel /ˈmɔːsl/ n. 一小口食物；少量食物
vocabulary.example: She only ate a tiny morsel of the dessert.
vocabulary.translation: 她只吃了一小口甜点。

vocabulary.entry: reproductive cycle /ˌriːprəˈdʌktɪv ˈsaɪkl/ n. 繁殖周期
vocabulary.example: The scientist is studying the reproductive cycle of jellyfish in the lab.
vocabulary.translation: 这位科学家正在实验室研究水母的繁殖周期。

vocabulary.entry: sustainable food source /səˈsteɪnəbl fuːd sɔːs/ n. 可持续食物来源
vocabulary.example: Jellyfish are considered a sustainable food source by some experts.
vocabulary.translation: 一些专家认为水母是一种可持续的食物来源。

vocabulary.entry: spawn /spɔːn/ v. （水生动物）产卵；繁殖
vocabulary.example: The fish spawn in the shallow waters of the bay every spring.
vocabulary.translation: 这种鱼每年春天都会在海湾的浅水区产卵。

vocabulary.entry: polyp /ˈpɒlɪp/ n. 水螅体
vocabulary.example: Jellyfish begin their lives as tiny polyps attached to the seabed.
vocabulary.translation: 水母的生命起始于附着在海床上的微小水螅体。

vocabulary.entry: nutritional value /njuːˈtrɪʃənl ˈvæljuː/ n. 营养价值
vocabulary.example: We need to consider the nutritional value of food when planning meals.
vocabulary.translation: 规划饮食时，我们需要考虑食物的营养价值。

vocabulary.entry: calorie /ˈkæləri/ n. 卡路里（热量单位）
vocabulary.example: This low-calorie drink is popular among people on diets.
vocabulary.translation: 这款低卡路里饮品很受减肥人群的欢迎。

vocabulary.entry: ounce /aʊns/ n. 盎司（重量单位）
vocabulary.example: The recipe calls for two ounces of butter.
vocabulary.translation: 这份食谱需要两盎司黄油。

vocabulary.entry: on a par with /ɒn ə pɑː wɪð/ 与……相当；与……同等水平
vocabulary.example: Her performance in the exam is on a par with the top students.
vocabulary.translation: 她的考试成绩与优等生不相上下。

vocabulary.entry: iceberg lettuce /ˈaɪsbɜːɡ ˈletɪs/ n. 卷心莴苣
vocabulary.example: Iceberg lettuce is often used in burgers and salads.
vocabulary.translation: 卷心莴苣常被用于制作汉堡和沙拉。

vocabulary.entry: protein /ˈprəʊtiːn/ n. 蛋白质
vocabulary.example: Eggs are a good source of protein for vegetarians.
vocabulary.translation: 鸡蛋是素食者获取蛋白质的优质来源。

vocabulary.entry: lucrative /ˈluːkrətɪv/ adj. 赚钱的；利润丰厚的
vocabulary.example: He started a lucrative business selling handmade crafts online.
vocabulary.translation: 他在网上卖手工艺品，做起了一门赚钱的生意。

vocabulary.entry: flavourless /ˈfleɪvələs/ adj. 无味的；没有味道的
vocabulary.example: The soup was bland and flavourless without any seasoning.
vocabulary.translation: 这道汤没放任何调料，寡淡无味。

vocabulary.entry: absorbent /əbˈsɔːbənt/ adj. 有吸附性的；能吸收的
vocabulary.example: This towel is made of highly absorbent cotton.
vocabulary.translation: 这条毛巾是用吸水性很强的棉布制成的。

vocabulary.entry: texture /ˈtekstʃə/ n. 口感；质地
vocabulary.example: The cake has a light and fluffy texture.
vocabulary.translation: 这款蛋糕口感松软蓬松。

vocabulary.entry: gristle /ˈɡrɪsl/ n. 软骨；脆骨
vocabulary.example: He doesn't like eating gristle in the meat dishes.
vocabulary.translation: 他不喜欢吃肉菜里的软骨。

vocabulary.entry: chow down /tʃaʊ daʊn/ （非正式）大快朵颐；狼吞虎咽地吃
vocabulary.example: We chowed down on pizza after the long hike.
vocabulary.translation: 长途徒步后，我们狼吞虎咽地吃起了披萨。

vocabulary.entry: alternative /ɔːlˈtɜːnətɪv/ n. 替代品；可供选择的事物
vocabulary.example: We need to find an alternative to plastic packaging.
vocabulary.translation: 我们需要找到塑料包装的替代品。

sentences.english: While giant sharks are more common sea monsters in films, jellyfish also pose a major threat in real life – with some able to kill people with their stings.

sentences.english: And the potential danger they cause doesn’t stop there, with reports of them attacking salmon farms, shutting down power stations and incapacitating warships.
sentences.chinese: 而且它们造成的潜在危险还不止于此，有报道称水母会袭击三文鱼养殖场、导致发电站停运，还能让军舰失去行动能力。

sentences.english: There are even some scientists in Australia researching whether box jellyfish could ultimately destroy our oceans – so could devouring them be a possible solution?
sentences.chinese: 澳大利亚甚至有科学家在研究，箱型水母是否最终会破坏我们的海洋生态——那么，吃掉它们会不会是一个可行的解决方案呢？

sentences.english: The huge number of jellyfish in our oceans means that if we did start eating them, there is already a large supply of these potential morsels to be dined on.
sentences.chinese: 海洋中水母的数量十分庞大，这意味着如果我们真的开始食用水母，这种潜在食材的供应量已经十分充足。

sentences.english: Also, some people argue that due to their reproductive cycle, jellyfish are actually a sustainable food source.
sentences.chinese: 此外，有人认为，基于水母的繁殖周期，它们其实是一种可持续的食物来源。

sentences.english: Removing a jellyfish from the ocean doesn’t stop new ones being born.
sentences.chinese: 从海洋中捕捞水母，并不会阻止新的水母诞生。

sentences.english: This is because they are spawned from polyps on the seabed.
sentences.chinese: 这是因为水母是由海床上的珊瑚虫繁殖而来的。

sentences.english: In some ways, you can compare them to apples. When you take an apple from a tree, the tree still goes on to produce more apples.
sentences.chinese: 在某种程度上，你可以把它们比作苹果——从树上摘下一个苹果，树依然会结出更多苹果。
那么水母的营养价值如何呢？

sentences.english: Jellyfish contain 36 calories per ounce, which puts it on a par with iceberg lettuce.
sentences.chinese: 每盎司水母仅含36卡路里热量，这与卷心莴苣的热量相当。

sentences.english: However, unlike lettuce, it is full of protein, making it potentially a great diet food.
sentences.chinese: 但和莴苣不同的是，水母富含蛋白质，因此有可能成为极佳的减肥食品。

sentences.english: And indeed, in many parts of the world, particularly in Asia, they are already consumed, often raw, fried or chopped up as part of a salad.
sentences.chinese: 事实上，在全球许多地区，尤其是亚洲，人们早已开始食用水母，通常会生吃、油炸，或是切碎后加入沙拉中。
